criteria.description: States that the task requires adding a public instance method `selectMaxWeight` to `Layer` for maximum-weight non-overlapping annotation selection.
States that the task requires adding a `best-disjoint` query operator to the `nav` library.

Records that `public Layer selectMaxWeight(ToDoubleFunction<Annotation> weightFunction)` in `alvisnlp-core/src/main/java/fr/inra/maiage/bibliome/alvisnlp/core/corpus/Layer.java` normalizes `Double.isNaN(weight)` to `0.0`.

Records that private `selectMaxWeight(double[] weights)` in `Layer.java` runs weighted-interval dynamic programming over non-zero-length annotations sorted by ascending `end` using `countEndingAtMost`.

Records that `alvisnlp-bibliome/src/main/java/fr/inra/maiage/bibliome/alvisnlp/bibliomefactory/library/standard/NavigationLibrary.java` adds `bestDisjoint(String layerName)` annotated with `@Function(firstFtor="best-disjoint", ftors=1, nameTypes={NameType.LAYER})`.
Records that the two `Evaluator` layer-name `bestDisjoint` overloads written in `NavigationLibrary.java` carry plain `@Function` with no `ftors` attribute.
Records that `BestDisjointEvaluator.java` defines `DEFAULT_WEIGHT = 1.0`.
Records that `collectUsedNames` in `BestDisjointEvaluator` calls `nameUsage.addNames(NameType.LAYER, layerName)` when `layerName != null`.
Records that `alvisnlp-core/src/main/java/fr/inra/maiage/bibliome/alvisnlp/core/annotation/LibraryModel.java` emits a warning when a library function `is not documented` in its documentation XML.
Records that `LibraryModel.java` warns (`the name types will be ignored`) when `nameTypes` is specified on a `@Function` method returning `Evaluator`.
Records that `pom.xml` in `/app` configures Java `1.8` compiler source.
Records that `Layer.java` implements lexicographic tie-breaking with tail-linked `SelectionIndices` nodes aligned by `dropIndices` for recursive comparison.
Explains that `best` in `Layer.java` compares DP totals with plain numeric operators rather than `Double.compare` so positive zero ties with negative zero under ordinary double arithmetic.

Explains that `BestDisjointEvaluator` calls `getLayerName(ctx, elt)` before `DownCastElement.toSection(elt)` because the specification only suppresses evaluating `WEIGHT` when the context downcast fails or the named layer is absent.

Explains that `Layer.java` processes zero-length annotations in a reverse canonical post-pass tracking `maxSelectedIndex` because descending traversal lets later selected indices serve as lexicographic anchors.

Explains that `alvisnlp-core/src/main/java/fr/inra/maiage/bibliome/alvisnlp/core/corpus/expressions/Expression.java` must add `best-disjoint` to the `libEllipsisToString(a)` case group in `navToString` because unlisted operators fall through to `defaultToString(a)` and keep the `nav:` prefix.
